---
name: Feature or workflow improvement
about: Describe a concrete research need and a verifiable outcome.
title: "[Feature] "
---

## Research task

What are you trying to accomplish, and which module or target is involved?

## Current limitation

What can you do today, and where does the current workflow fall short?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful change and any alternatives you considered.

## Verification

What public fixture, documented command or observable behavior would demonstrate success? Keep software checks distinct from scientific validation.

## Inputs and environment

List relevant formats, software versions and platform. Do not publish private molecules, unpublished data or credentials.
